title: The Look — Shih Tzu Comfort Colors Tee
description:
One look. A whole conversation.

For the person who knows exactly what that little face is saying. The Look pairs a vintage-style Shih Tzu illustration with THE LOOK and IF YOU KNOW, YOU KNOW — a quiet nod to life with a very expressive best friend.

Planned on the Comfort Colors 1717: a relaxed-fit, garment-dyed tee in heavyweight 6.1 oz, 100% ring-spun US cotton. Made for slow mornings, neighborhood walks, and anyone who has ever been judged by a Shih Tzu.

Choose your favorite from Ivory, Blossom, Butter, Bay, and Espresso. Final color/size availability and printed appearance will be confirmed before release.

Care: machine wash cold; do not bleach; tumble dry low. Iron on low, avoiding the printed design. Do not dry clean.

OWNER REVIEW DRAFT — unavailable for purchase. Artwork and retail proposal are ready for review; supplier variants, mockups, costs, and a printed sample remain unverified.
